scope: Automated PCI QEMU runtime acceptance of the pinned Demo/Graphics/CommonAncestor.ZC on the ARM64 graphical terminal. The probe allows the original tree builder to finish, confirms the colored tree rendered, sends a key to complete PressAKey, verifies terminal recovery where 40+2 evaluates to 42, and confirms zstatus failed=0. This does not establish live UTM or Raspberry Pi behavior.
